# Hypercap-CC-NLP

Repository: https://github.com/reblocke/Hypercap-CC-NLP
Repository status: public journal-submission code release; restricted inputs remain excluded.
Current software release: v0.1.1 metadata refresh of the v0.1.0 sanitized code snapshot.
The IMV timing sensitivity and acceptance safeguards are unreleased changes, not
part of v0.1.1. Cite the repository and exact commit SHA for unreleased code;
the version/date in CITATION.cff continue to describe the published release.

## Purpose

This repository contains Quarto-first Python code for a MIMIC-IV study of
emergency department chief complaint profiles in hypercapnic respiratory failure.
The pipeline assembles a hypercapnia cohort, classifies presenting concerns into
NHAMCS Reason-for-Visit categories, evaluates rater agreement and NLP benchmark
performance, and generates manuscript-facing aggregate tables and figures.

## Scholarly Records

- Current manuscript preprint: Emergency Department Presenting Concerns Among
  Admissions With Hypercapnia: A Retrospective NLP Study of MIMIC-IV.
- Preprint citation: Merdad RH, Ramirez M, Christenson M, Pettine WW, Locke BW.
  medRxiv. 2026.
- Preprint DOI: https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.03.26357242
- Preprint record: https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.07.03.26357242v1
- ATS 2026 abstract: C75-09 Chief Complaint Profiles in Hypercapnic Respiratory
  Failure: A Natural Language Processing Study of MIMIC-IV.
- Abstract DOI: https://doi.org/10.1093/ajrccm/aamag162.4737
- Abstract page: https://academic.oup.com/ajrccm/article/212/Supplement_1/aamag162.4737/8684677
- Journal/proceedings metadata: American Journal of Respiratory and Critical Care
  Medicine, 2026, volume 212, issue Supplement_1.
- Manuscript status: medRxiv preprint posted; no final journal article has been
  accepted or published.

## Data Sources And Restrictions

- MIMIC-IV HOSP/ICU v3.1 via PhysioNet/BigQuery; cite DOI 10.13026/kpb9-mt58.
- The official derived concepts dataset must provide accessible `_metadata` and
  `ventilation` tables, with exactly one `mimic_version = 3.1` attribute/value
  record. `BQ_DATASET_DERIVED` defaults to `mimiciv_derived`; the restricted run
  verified on 2026-08-25 used `BQ_DATASET_DERIVED=mimiciv_3_1_derived` explicitly.
  Neither a derived `bg` table nor legacy regex timing is a fallback.
- MIMIC-IV-ED v2.2 via PhysioNet/BigQuery; cite DOI 10.13026/5ntk-km72.
- MIMIC-IV-Note is not required for the current pipeline unless future note-based
  extensions are added.
- Required local handoff workbooks and annotation workbooks are restricted and
  ignored by git.
- This repository must not contain row-level MIMIC data, encounter identifiers,
  annotation workbooks, generated debug logs, or credentials.

## Pipeline Order

1. `MIMICIV_hypercap_EXT_cohort.qmd`: cohort assembly from BigQuery-backed
   MIMIC-IV HOSP/ICU/ED tables and official derived ventilation concepts.
2. `Hypercap CC NLP Classifier.qmd`: chief complaint normalization and RFV
   classification.
3. `Rater Agreement Analysis.qmd`: human rater agreement and NLP benchmark
   analysis against adjudicated labels.
4. `Hypercap CC NLP Analysis.qmd`: manuscript tables, figures, and submission
   asset bundle.

## IMV Timing Sensitivity

The secondary, descriptive IMV timing sensitivity compares the earliest
qualifying gas with the first reliable observed IMV timestamp. It preserves the
primary cohort and RFV taxonomy and does not establish that IMV caused
hypercapnia. The normative definitions and validation gates are in `docs/SPEC.md`.

- The eleven admission-level timing fields belong only in the ignored private
  handoffs; never commit or publish their rows. Split-machine execution requires
  an approved restricted-data transfer, not repository synchronization alone.
- Aggregate outputs are `IMV_Qualifying_Gas_Timing_Sensitivity.xlsx` (seven sheets),
  `Figure S10.pdf`, `Figure S10.xlsx`, and `imv_timing_manuscript_summary.md` under
  `Results/YYYY-MM-DD/`; cohort QA is
  `artifacts/qa/cohort/imv_qualifying_gas_timing_audit.csv`.
- `scripts/imv_ticket_parity.py` verifies the captured baseline's integrity and
  compares membership, RFV assignments, and 14 existing workbooks. Baselines and
  reports stay ignored; never recapture a baseline to remove a parity failure.

## Commands

```bash
uv sync --frozen
uv run pytest -q
uv run ruff check src tests
quarto check
make -n quarto-pipeline RESULTS_DATE=2026-05-30
```

Full private execution requires authorized MIMIC/BigQuery access and the ignored
local input workbooks. Missing private inputs are expected in a clean public clone.

## Public Release Policy

- Git tracks source code, tests, documentation, specs, and public classifier
  resources only.
- Aggregate manuscript figures/tables may be distributed as GitHub or Zenodo
  release assets with checksums and a manifest.
- Do not commit generated PDFs, Excel workbooks, release ZIPs,
  debug folders, or row-level data.
- See `data_dictionary.md` and `data_dictionary.csv` for variable-level
  documentation without restricted rows.

## Agent Cautions

- Keep the root `CITATION.cff` as a software citation. The medRxiv preprint and
  ATS abstract are separate related scholarly outputs until a final article exists.
- Do not copy abstract/manuscript text into Markdown beyond concise original
  summaries and citation metadata.
- Do not remove MIMIC access warnings or make the pipeline appear runnable without
  restricted inputs.
- Preserve the Quarto notebook stage ownership described in `docs/SPEC.md`.
